source: duplex runtime workstream (Build: duplex runtime, 2026-10-04): src/duplex/{host,governor,engineRules,adapter,overlap,face,markers,config}.ts, server/duplex/{fanin,echo,partialSafety,speculator,buildIntent,slice,routes}.js, evals/duplex/tick-sim.mjs (M-D7), tests/duplex-runtime.test.mjs, docs/research/duplex/INTEGRATION.md. Merge AFTER context/inbox/duplex-v2.json (edges point at its nodes).

nodes.title: Duplex v2 runtime shape: a device-side EngineHost (src/duplex/host.ts) builds one EngineTick per 100 ms timer AND per stream event (20 ms frames' voice edges, STT partial/final, her playback start/verdict/end/stopped, screen, Director context, async estimate) and runs engine.tick behind the ONE code governor (src/duplex/governor.ts, G1-G11); engines come from one factory (src/duplex/adapter.ts createEngine): stage A rules (engineRules.ts) today, TrainedEngine (ONNX via an injected onnxruntime, feature spec cce-features/1, <= 20 MB, falls back to stage A on any stale tick) when flags.trained AND a model are present, so stage B lands with no code change. The server slice (server/duplex/slice.js + routes.js) keeps the authorities the device must not hold: partials fan-in with the lexical horizon (fanin.js), known-text echo subtraction of her own TTS words (echo.js), sticky safety on every partial (partialSafety.js, the shipped scanSafety), speculative drafts + TTS warm-up of the code-built uptake driven by the PrepareHint stream with cancellation (speculator.js), build intents from partials (buildIntent.js; misconception values server-only). Hands-free and full-session: no press/release API anywhere in the duplex modules (test-asserted); push-to-talk survives only as the W2 recording/typed fallback. Shadow mode emits log rows only (numbers + closed codes, never child words). Reverse if: the host's per-tick cost on a low-end Android (DX-1) exceeds 5 ms p95 or the event-tick design misses a decision the timer would catch; then fold event ticks into the 100 ms timer (decisions only, perception stays continuous).

Fast mouth, late verdict: the verdict-bearing words of a closed-answer reply play no earlier than the child's last value end + 2.0 s (config VERDICT.delayMs; was 1.2 s in the v2 draft). The first sound (the code-built uptake of the child's own value) is not delayed: only the verdict segment, which the player holds (INTEGRATION.md §4). Evidence M-D7 (n = 96 scenarios x 10 seeds, fast word-timed lane): verdict played before the child finished / on a value the child then repaired = 13/9 of 379 at 1.2 s, 4/4 at 1.6 s, 0/0 at 2.0 s; first-audio p50 unchanged (2,027 vs 2,019 ms). Caveat: tuned on one author's scripted self-corrections (repair pauses 400-1,500 ms +-20 %), so it is a corpus bound, not a child bound. Reverse if: DX-6 on TaxilaFDB or real consented children shows repairs after a value pause > 2.0 s at a rate that matters (then raise, or key it to the child's own repair-pause p90), or that 2.0 s reads as unnatural hesitation in a blind listen against 1.2-1.6 s with 0 wrong-value verdicts.

Overlap while she speaks: a burst still voicing at 250-449 ms is UNDECIDED (stay ducked at 0.2, keep listening) instead of adding +1.0 barge-in evidence (config OVERLAP.earlyVoicedZ = 0); it yields at the sustain threshold (OVERLAP.sustainedMs: 450 ms here; 600 ms after the TaxilaFDB tuning workstream), on a raised/rising onset, after her yes/no question (~200-300 ms), or when words land; a burst that ends short reads as a continuer and she un-ducks. The reflex duck at onset (~40 ms) already backs her voice off. Evidence M-D7 fast lane: the eager rule yielded on 20/30 continuers ('हम्म/अच्छा/ओके' over her) and resumed ~0.8 s later, vs 0/30 now; cost: barge-in yield p50 500 ms (fast) / 600 ms (D4, MAI) vs 300 ms (yes/no answers still yield at 300 ms). Reverse if: on real audio (DX-5) the stay-ducked rule's barge-in yield p50 exceeds 600 ms or children re-try their interruption, while the eager rule's continuer false-yields stay under 10 %.

Stage A without a fresh semantic read is uncertain about the end of a teach-back: in open_explanation a finished SENTENCE (verb-final, falling contour) caps pComplete at 0.8 < speakPc 0.9 (engineRules.ts EXPLAIN_SENTENCE_CAP), so only a fresh semantic estimate on the same text, an idk / complete question / repeat request, or the governor's context backstop (B3: 2.0 s at decision time, 2.5 s after the TaxilaFDB tuning change; x2.5 on an open tail) ends it. Evidence M-D7 (pre-cap dev run, 3 seeds): 'triangle के तीन sides होते हैं' + 1.6 s pause and 'जो ऊपर होता है ना' were taken over 3/3 and 3/3 (revoked before audio only because the reply was slow); after the cap 0 hard cut-offs in explanations; explanation gap p50 ~2.03 s on every lane (~2.53 s with the raised backstop) (the price, paid until the semantic call lands). Reverse when: the semantic arm (server/duplex/semantic.js, taxila-fast) is measured on TaxilaFDB F2 with thinking-pause cut-offs <= silence-640 on the same audio; then the cap applies only while the semantic estimate is stale.

The safeguard never plays over the child: a child onset while the safeguard is committed or audible defers it (governor YIELD reason safety, back to safety_attend, re-decided at the next pause; the distress state stays sticky and the safeguard is never dropped). Evidence M-D7 j05 ('मुझे मर जाना है' + 1.2 s pause + more words): 5/10 seeds had the safeguard decided in the pause and the child resume 16-130 ms before its first sound; after the fix 0 safeguards audible over child voice for > 120 ms on every lane; stops within <= 120 ms of a child onset (onset detector 40 ms + one frame tick + word-boundary stop 50 ms) are counted separately: 3 (D4) / 10 (MAI, fast) of 70 distress turns. Reverse if: real sessions show a child who keeps talking in short bursts never gets the safeguard within 10 s; then speak it at the first >= 1.5 s pause even mid-turn (still never over voice).

G3 grants a hold request only on words that describe the child's latest audio (unseenVoicedMs <= 120 ms) and only once per text; a granted hold ends when new words land that no longer end on a hold request (no voice onset needed), and the words after the hold phrase are the answer (markers read the form on understand.tailText, so 'एक मिनट … बारह' is 12, not the list 1, 12). Evidence: M-D7 h01 regression (rejection rj-duplex-stale-hold-regrant); after the fix hold violations 0 and missed turn ends 0 on all CCE lanes, hold_request gap p50 365-469 ms on MAI/fast. Reverse if: real partials revise a hold phrase INTO the tail often enough that the freshness test drops real holds (then key the grant on the hold words' own end time).

M-D7 (2026-10-04, $0, no network): the v2 runtime at tick level. Method: evals/duplex/tick-sim.mjs replays evals/duplex/scenarios.mjs (96 scripted Hinglish child turns, 10 categories, one author) x 10 seeds = 960 turns per arm through the REAL src/duplex/host.ts → engineRules.ts → governor.ts with server/duplex/speculator.js on the think track; streams.mjs frames (20 ms RMS/F0) and reactive STT (D4 calibrated from M-D2 n=28; MAI_HOME and FAST are [E] priors); her replies scheduled from the host's own speak commands (first audio = decision + bootstrapped measured Director/TTS stages, or the warm uptake / promoted draft). The tree includes the parallel TaxilaFDB tuning edits (sustain 600 ms, explanation backstop 2.5-3.5 s). Results (gap = decision after the child's true end; ttfa = first audio): cce-mai gap p50/p90 361/2,546 ms (closed answers p50 308-352 / p90 385-425), ttfa p50 1,888; cce-fast 400/2,546 (closed 300-366 / 537-587), ttfa 2,019; cce-d4 1,265/2,546, ttfa 2,672; cascade-900 1,895/2,360, ttfa 3,800; silence-640 1,590/2,077, ttfa 3,500. Hard cut-offs (an audible non-uptake turn before the child finished) 0.0 % on all CCE arms vs 2.9 % cascade-900 and 3.9 % silence-640; early verdict-free uptakes the child talked over (revoked at their onset) 9.1 % MAI, 8.4 % fast, 1.3 % D4 (self-correction / hesitant scripts). Hold violations 0 % vs 31.7 % / 38.3 %. Verdicts before the child finished or on a repaired value 0/0 of 370 (baselines 8/325 and 13/314 wrong-value). Unsafe non-safeguard lines 0 (cce-fast-nospec 1: an idk reply audible 7 ms after the distress segment began, before its words existed); safeguard over child voice > 120 ms 0. Overlap accuracy 99.5 % fast, 96.3 % MAI, 94.7 % D4 vs 79.5 % / 77.4 %; yield p50 500 ms fast (yes/no 300), 600 ms D4/MAI. Think-while-listening cuts ttfa p50 by 451-844 ms; warm uptake promoted on 44-48 % of speaks; wasted speculative tokens 20 % (MAI) to 61 % (fast). Explanations end by the stage A backstop (~2.53 s). Ablations: eager overlap 20/30 continuers yielded-then-resumed; verdict delay 1.2/1.6/2.0 s → 9/4/0 wrong-value verdicts. Caveats: synthetic voice/contours (short rising 'क्या?' too flat for the acoustic repair rule), no echo in frames, MAI/FAST latencies estimated, one author, chosen category mix; Smart Turn off the shelf not an arm. Pooled gap p90 misses the <= 700 ms target (explanations); closed answers on MAI/fast meet it.

Tried: the fan-in kept ONE pending client-commit time (commitAt) and gave it to the next final as its audio coverage. What broke (M-D7 b04 on D4): the micro-commit probe fires once per voiced run, so a second probe (3,300 ms) overwrote the first (2,400 ms) before the first final landed; that final ('हम्म सात आठ') was then read as covering audio to 3,300 ms, the lexical horizon saw 0 unseen voice while 'छप्पन' was unspoken-in-text, the engine spoke and a verdict played on 8 instead of 56 (2 of 30 runs; 4 with no speculation). Replaced by: a FIFO commit queue (each final consumes the oldest commit at or after its item's audio start; coverage = the earlier of that commit and the source's own audio end) + a unit test.

Tried: G3 entered hold_requested whenever markers.holdRequest was true on the child's floor and the child was silent, and left it only on a voice onset. What broke (M-D7 h01, 'एक मिनट' … 3.5 s … 'हाँ, बारह'): at the offset after the answer the transcript still showed only 'एक मिनट' (the answer's words not landed), so the hold was re-granted on stale words; when 'हाँ, बारह' landed (pComplete 0.997) the phase stayed hold_requested, the turn never ended and the 8 s check-in look played to a child who had answered. Replaced by decision duplex-hold-grant-fresh-words.

Tried: after a resumable yield with no words yet, resume her line after 1,600 ms of silence (the v1 bargein.js NO_TEXT_RESUME_MS). What broke (M-D7 i08): D4's first words of a fresh burst arrive 1.7-2.0 s after its onset (M-D2 p90 2,048 ms), so she resumed over a child's 'रुको' whose words had simply not arrived; 'no text' meant 'not transcribed yet'. Replaced by: resume only after the source's first-text p90 + 300 ms measured from the overlap onset (config FIRST_TEXT_P90: live_transcribe 2,048 [T], mai_stream 3,200 [T], nemotron 800 [E]).

Tried: the v2-draft overlap rule added +1.0 barge-in evidence once a burst over her had voiced 250 ms (aiming at 'yield <= 200 ms'). What broke (M-D7): continuers last ~300-400 ms, so 'हम्म' / 'अच्छा' / 'ओके' crossed 250 ms still voicing and yielded; she stopped mid-sentence and resumed ~0.8 s later on 20/30 continuer turns (fast lane), a stop-start a child hears as being interrupted for nodding. Replaced by decision duplex-overlap-stay-ducked (the reflex duck carries the first 450 ms).

Open: on a word-timed fast STT the PrepareHint stream relaunches speculative drafts as words land (cap 3/turn, 300 ms debounce, >= 1 new word): 63 % of speculative tokens wasted (~4.0k tokens/turn, M-D7 cce-fast) vs 22 % on MAI. Needs a DX-4 sweep of minNewWords / debounce / launching on stablePrefix only, against the ttfa it buys.

Open: server/duplex/semantic.js (the stage A fast-LLM completeness read on a stable prefix; host.ts already calls opts.semantic and engineRules weights it, decaying over 1.5 s, stale on a new text hash) is not built. Until it is, open explanations end only by the ~2.0 s backstop (duplex-explain-sentence-cap) and off-task drift never fires (it needs semantic.offTask). M-D5's taxila-fast numbers (accuracy 127/140 at 0.5, p50 963 ms) are the prior.

Known-text echo subtraction removes only her words that were audible INSIDE the audio a transcript version describes: the fan-in passes each version's audio span (item start → word end / commit / arrival − lag) and, on word-timed sources, per-token times (a token is echo only if heard while her matching word was audible, ±300 ms); the single-token 'fresh echo' rule (added by the TaxilaFDB workstream) must match the surface form, not the consonant skeleton, and without token times only in the last two tokens; her UPTAKE (the child's own words re-voiced) is never subtracted. Evidence M-D7: before, 'हाँ' over her yes/no question was deleted as her 'हैं' (shared skeleton) and she resumed over the answer on 30/30 fast-lane turns; her uptake 'तीन बटा आठ' deleted the child's correction 'तीन बटा चार' → verdicts on 4 instead of 3/4 (2/30 MAI, 2/30 fast). After: 0 wrong-value verdicts on every lane. Reverse if: DX-7 on recorded speaker sessions shows the guards leave real echo that self-yields; then add the playback-level correlation (layer 3), never widen the text match.

Tried (TaxilaFDB tuning workstream, 2026-10-04, against self-yields on word-timed streams): drop a single transcript token as echo when its consonant skeleton matches one of her words that ended within 1 s, anywhere in the text. What broke (M-D7): skeletons are too lossy for one word ('हाँ' = 'हैं' = 'h'), so a child's yes over her yes/no question vanished and she resumed over it (30/30 fast-lane turns); and it matched every occurrence, so her uptake 'तीन' deleted both of the child's own 'तीन's, the first spoken a second before hers (wrong-value verdicts). Replaced by decision duplex-echo-span-and-uptake (surface match, tail-only without token times, time-aligned with them, uptake never subtracted).
